goal: Add baseline rate-limit middleware at apps/api/app/middleware/rate_limit.py wired into apps/api/app/main.py with env-toggleable thresholds (RATE_LIMIT_ANON, RATE_LIMIT_AUTH) so every derived product has rate limiting on by default.
acceptance_criteria: 1. apps/api/app/middleware/rate_limit.py implements per-IP token bucket using starlette middleware | 2. apps/api/app/main.py registers the middleware behind a feature flag | 3. apps/api/app/core/config.py exposes RATE_LIMIT_* settings

goal: Add baseline security headers middleware at apps/api/app/middleware/security_headers.py setting HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and a strict default CSP with env override.
acceptance_criteria: 1. apps/api/app/middleware/security_headers.py sets all four headers and a configurable CSP | 2. apps/api/app/main.py registers the middleware | 3. apps/api/app/core/config.py exposes CSP_POLICY and SECURITY_HEADERS_ENABLED

goal: Add baseline auth audit log middleware at apps/api/app/middleware/audit_log.py that emits structured JSON log lines for login, logout, password-change, and 401/403 responses so every product ships with auditability.
acceptance_criteria: 1. apps/api/app/middleware/audit_log.py logs auth events as JSON to stdout | 2. apps/api/app/main.py registers the middleware after rate-limit and security headers | 3. apps/api/app/core/config.py exposes AUDIT_LOG_ENABLED toggle
